whenToUse: Labeled inputs, selects, text areas and code entry with optional hint text under the control
Preference and permission lists where every switch or checkbox has a title and a description
Validation states with a red label and one error, or a list of them, under the control

whenNotToUse.when: A complete page for entering or editing a record, such as an invoice or a profile
A full page of toggle rows for alert channels, app integrations or workspace options
A numeric value stepped with plus and minus buttons or scrubbed by dragging

agentNotes: `FieldTitle` is a plain div, so a `Checkbox` or `Switch` titled only by it has no accessible name; point a `FieldLabel` at its id instead
`data-invalid` on `Field` only sets a red text color, which its label inherits; the control turns red from aria-invalid, which no example sets
Nothing ties `FieldDescription` or `FieldError` to the control; give them ids and list those in the control's aria-describedby
